name: chaos_checkout_rescue
description: Confirms an order whose chaos_checkout execution failed, timed out or was terminated, using only the original checkout input. This is what makes checkout always complete.

inputParameters.queryExpression: ((.lines // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end) as $raw | (.customer | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $c | {name: (($c.name // "") | tostring | if . == "" then "Valued Customer" else . end), address: (($c.address // "") | tostring)} as $customer | (.paymentMethod | if type == "object" then . else {id: "iou", label: "A Handwritten IOU"} end) as $method | ($raw | map(select(type == "object")) | map({productId: ((.productId // "unknown") | tostring), name: ((.name // "Something You Wanted") | tostring), emoji: ((.emoji // "📦") | tostring), unitPriceCents: ((.unitPriceCents // 0) | if type == "number" and . > 0 then floor else 0 end), quantity: ((.quantity // 1) | if type == "number" then (if . < 1 then 1 elif . > 99 then 99 else floor end) else 1 end)}) | map(. + {lineTotalCents: (.unitPriceCents * .quantity)})) as $lines | (if ($lines | length) == 0 then [{productId: "mandatory-mystery-item", name: "Mandatory Mystery Item", emoji: "❓", unitPriceCents: 1313, quantity: 1, lineTotalCents: 1313, note: "We could not read your cart, so we guessed."}] else $lines end) as $lines | ($lines | map(.lineTotalCents) | add) as $sub | ((.failedWorkflowId // "napkin00") | tostring) as $id | {orderNumber: ("CHAOS-" + ($id[0:8] | ascii_upcase)), status: "CONFIRMED", rescued: true, rescuedFrom: {workflowId: .failedWorkflowId, status: (.failureStatus // "UNKNOWN")}, placedAt: ((.placedAt // "") | tostring), customer: $customer, lines: $lines, itemCount: ($lines | map(.quantity) | add), cartWasEmpty: (($raw | length) == 0), subtotalCents: $sub, fees: [{code: "NAPKIN", label: "Emergency Napkin Fee (we wrote your order on one)", amountCents: 299}], totalCents: ($sub + 299), payment: {status: "TAB_OPENED", amountCents: ($sub + 299), method: $method, attempts: [], note: "The payment system is currently on fire, so we opened a tab. A man named Gary will be in touch."}, inventory: {items: [], substitutions: 0, blocksCheckout: false}, vibeCheck: {score: 0, vibe: "smoky", verdict: "FINE_PROBABLY", proceed: true, note: "Fraud check skipped. The vibes were unavailable due to fire."}, shipping: {carrier: "Whoever Is Still In The Building", eta: "eventually", trackingNumber: "CC-NAPKIN", destination: $customer.address, note: "Tracking updates are available by shouting."}, message: "Our checkout system caught fire, so we wrote your order on a napkin. Order confirmed anyway."}
